title: #33 pop-in opt-in, harness rows (M6 DRAFT 2026-11-25): cold attract via harness\run-game.ps1 + harness\routes\attract-long.txt. Not a run-matrix.ps1 file; it is the --matrix-json for w6_kit.py harness mode (--run ARM=DIR) and the arm table of TESTPLAN.md
notes: Each arm = one harness\run-game.ps1 run (FUNCTIONAL ONLY, hidden desktop): -BinDir <bin> -Seconds <seconds> -GpuLog -Tag s33-<id> -RunsRoot build\agent6\runs-s33 -InputScript harness\routes\attract-long.txt -Cvar '<cvars joined with ;>' [-SeedXenos <dir>]. run.json then holds the cvars dict the kit compares against 'cvars' here (listed keys only; harness\legodimensions.toml defaults such as framerate_limit = 60 are the same in every arm).

slow_frame_log_ms=1 in every sf / on / gate / diag arm (not 17 as in matrix-s33-draft.json): at the harness's 60 fps cap most frames take ~16.7 ms, so a 17 ms threshold would hide the dropped-draw tail of ON in fast frames (DESIGN.md section 8: '1 (or 17)'). Counters reset at every swap whether or not the line prints.

onwarm seeds the Xenos storage (*.xsh, *.xpso) of an offsf run OF THE SAME BIN (user\cache\shaders\shareable of that run dir) through -SeedXenos, the documented warm-storage path; never seeds from another bin. offwarm is its cvar-off twin with the same seed (row 5 compares onwarm with offwarm).

onstop: 5 runs with -Seconds 203, 205, 207, 209 and 211, so WM_CLOSE lands in or near the 67-miss burst (~H0+21 s, H0 ~launch+180..187 s); each run's log must show pipeline misses within ~2 s before 'Window closing, shutting down' for it to count (TESTPLAN.md row 4).

Bins: base = build/agent2/devoff4b-bin; patched = build/agent2/devoff4b-s33-bin (provisional); offd/ond = a bin with diagnostic (d): build/agent2/devoff4b-s33d-bin if built separately, else devoff4b-s33-bin.

arms.note: row 1a: patched, cvar off, slow-frame log off: must equal base
row 1b; reference for rows 2 and 6; dropped draws 0 in every line in frames outside submissions with misses
row 4: close during the burst, 5 runs
diagnostic (d), cvar off: today's one-submission drop exposure
